# Local browser dependencies

| File | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| qrcode.js | 1.4.4 | https://unpkg.com/qrcode-generator@1.4.4/qrcode.js | MIT, QRCODE-LICENSE.txt |
| jsQR.js | 1.4.0 | https://unpkg.com/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js | Apache-2.0, JSQR-LICENSE.txt |

Downloaded at implementation time. Runtime uses only these same-origin files.
Their SHA-256 hashes are recorded in the catalog manifest. N3 and the baseline
styles are reused from the existing shared vendors. CCO attribution is in
ontology/CCO-LICENSE.txt. Existing portrait originals are preserved.
